## Scope

Describe what this pull request changes in Speccanopy's architecture-design software, research documentation, or test fixtures.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `pytest -q` (or explain why not).
- [ ] New functionality has tests or an explicit manual verification protocol.
- [ ] I considered schema compatibility, architectural traceability and honest incomplete/review statuses.

## Research and privacy checks

- [ ] This change does not contain credentials, private system diagrams, personal contact details, confidential briefs or raw private reviewer submissions.
- [ ] Any synthetic / scripted / unverified evidence is labeled as such.
- [ ] Any externally sourced material is cited and has an appropriate license or specific permission for reuse.
- [ ] I do not represent structural checks or self-declared expert reviews as independent certification.

## Limitations and follow-ups

List any outstanding design concerns, unresolved requirements or subsequent validation work. Speccanopy creates architecture specifications, not the implementation of applications it designs.
